relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: Harissa's smoky and spicy profile complements the tangy flavors of preserved lemon in couscous, creating a vibrant dish.

relations.name: Berbere
relations.rationale: Harissa and berbere share similar spice profiles, making berbere a fitting base for recipes that enhance the depth of flavor in sauces and marinades.

relations.name: Ras el Hanout
relations.rationale: Ras el Hanout's complex spice blend can be used alongside harissa for added depth and warmth in various dishes.

relations.name: Mojo rojo
relations.rationale: The spicy and tangy elements of mojo rojo pair well with the heat of harissa, making for dynamic flavor combinations in grilled meats or vegetables.
